sara (People Ops): Heads-up: two short but important updates rolling out June 15 -> Leave Conversion Pilot + International Travel Safety Addendum. Quick summary first, full details in the linked policy.

sara (People Ops): 1) Leave Conversion Pilot: starting Jun 15 employees can opt to convert up to 16 unused PTO hours per calendar year into a taxable wellness stipend paid quarterly. This is opt-in at the individual level; opt-out by default. 2) Travel Safety Addendum: for company-approved trips >5 days or to countries flagged as 'elevated risk', travelers must complete a Travel Risk Assessment and acknowledge a 2-min Code of Conduct & Safety checklist before the trip is approved.

sara (People Ops): Why: were testing a small flexible benefit that helps folks who prefer cash over extra carryover, and were standardizing pre-travel checks after some near-miss incidents last quarter.

devon (Eng): Quick Q: who is eligible to opt-in for leave conversion? Full-timers only?
anton (Finance): Good Q. Everyone on the payroll (FT, PT with >=24 hrs/wk, and contractors on >4 month engagements) can participate, but contractors receive a prorated cash amount (max 8 hours equivalent). Payroll will handle tax withholding at distribution.

sara (People Ops): Eligibility note: PT staff must hit the 90-day employment threshold to enroll; enrollments can be backdated to the current calendar year if you hit eligibility before Jun 15. Contractors: talk to your hiring manager + Finance for enrollment.

lee (EMEA Ops): For the Travel Safety Addendum, does the checklist replace regional travel approvals or add to them? EU-specific GDPR concerns?

sara (People Ops): Its additive not replacement. The checklist captures behavioral expectations, emergency contacts, and local partner numbers. For EU trips we include a GDPR-safe sample consent for local support partners; no health data is stored centrally unless you opt-in to emergency assistance.

travel-bot: Policy v2.0 posted: /policies/leave-conversion-and-travel-safety (internal). Effective 2026-06-15.

anton (Finance): Admin notes for managers: - You can enable your reports to opt-in via People Admin. - Converted hours are taken from unused PTO balance up to the 16-hr cap; if you don’t have the hours we can’t convert. - For contractors we flag payments as "Contractor wellness stipend" on invoices where applicable.

devon (Eng): If someone opts in and then leaves mid-year, what happens to the stipend?
anton (Finance): If you separate before payout, we prorate the stipend to the payout date and process with final pay. If termination is involuntary for cause, standard final pay rules apply (see separation policy).

sara (People Ops): Travel logistics: for approved trips we now provide a small Travel Safety Pack (prepaid local SIM option + emergency cash card). Request via Travel Portal when booking; virtual SIM provisioning for many regions is automated. Physical packs require a 7-10 business day lead.

lee (EMEA Ops): Any reimbursement or cash usage limits for the emergency card?
anton (Finance): There is a per-trip emergency cash allocation (default $500 USD equivalent) for immediate needs; any spend must be reconciled with receipts within 14 days. Non-emergency expenses are not covered.

sara (People Ops): AMAs: well run two 20-min office hours next Tue (noon PT) and Wed (4pm CET). Calendar invites & a short explainer will go out in #people-ops. If you need a team-wide walkthrough, reply here or book a slot with me.

travel-bot: Reminder: pre-travel checklist will block approvals after 2026-06-15 for trips that match criteria.

devon (Eng): Thanks — appreciate the clarity. Will managers be notified when a report opts in?
sara (People Ops): Yes managers get an email + People Admin notification. Managers approve the opt-in only to ensure accrual/coverage makes sense for the team schedule.

lee (EMEA Ops): Useful. Will review regional appendix and share with the EMEA GTM team.
sara (People Ops): Thanks all. Link again: /policies/leave-conversion-and-travel-safety (internal). :white_check_mark:
